senses.gloss:
मञ्च् मञ्च्, cl. 1. A. मञ्चते, &c., to
cheat; to be wicked, &c. (= rts. मच्,
1. मुच्, मुञ्च्); to hold; to grow high or tall; to
adore; to shine; to go, move.

मञ्च, अस्, m. a stage or platform supported by
columns, a scaffold or temporary structure erected for
spectators on festive occasions; an elevated shed
raised on bamboos in a field (where a watchman is
stationed to protect the crop from cattle, birds, &c.);
a bedstead, couch, bed, sofa; a chair; a seat of
state, throne; a pulpit.
—मञ्च-मण्डप, अस्, m.
a sort of temporary open shed standing upon bamboo
posts; a platform erected for marriage ceremonies or
other festive occasions.

मञ्चक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a stage, platform, tem-
porary scaffold erected on a house; a couch, bed;
any frame or stand; a kind of brazier or stand for
holding fire; (इका), f. = आसन्दी, a chair; a trough,
tray.
—मञ्चकाश्रय (˚क-आश्˚), अस्, m. ‘bed-
infesting,’ a bed-bug, house-bug.
—मञ्चकासुर
(˚क-अस्˚), अस्, m., N. of an Asura.
—मञ्चकासुर-
दुन्दुभि-वध, अस्, m., N. of a chapter of the
Krīḍā-khaṇḍa of the Gaṇeśa-Purāṇa.

मञ्चयाय्य, अस्, m., N. of a brother of Cauṇḍa-
pācārya.
मञ्चुका in मदन-मञ्चुका, q. v.

मञ्ज् मञ्ज् (connected with rts. मार्ज्,
मृज्), cl. 10. P. मञ्जयति, -यितुम्, to
wipe, clean, cleanse, purify, wipe off; to sound.

मञ्जर, अम्, n. a cluster of blossoms; a species
of plant (= तिलक); a pearl; [cf. देव-म्˚.]

मञ्जरि, इस्, or मञ्जरी, f. a cluster of blossoms;
a compound pedicle or flower-stalk, a branching
flower-stalk; a flower-bud; a shoot, sprout, sprig,
stalk, (often at the end of titles of works, cf. प्र-
दीप-म्˚); N. of a work by Bhaṭṭācārya-cūḍāmaṇi
(abbreviated fr. the full title Nyāya-siddhānta-mañ-
jarī); a parallel line or row; a species of plant (=
तिलक); N. of a metre, four times ˘˘¯˘¯,
˘˘˘¯˘¯¯˘¯; of another consisting of four lines
of 12, 8, 16, and 20 syllables; a pearl; a creeper;
= तुलसी, holy basil; [cf. Gr. μάργαρον, μαργαρίτης;
Lat. margarita.]
—मञ्जरी-चामर, अम्, n. a
fan-like sprout.
—मञ्जरी-नम्र, अस्, m. ‘bent
down with clusters of flowers,’ the plant Calamus
Rotang.
—मञ्जरी-पिञ्जरित, अस्, आ, अम्, having
pearls and gold.
—मञ्जरी-प्रकाश or न्याय-
सिद्धान्त-मञ्जरी-प्रकाश, अस्, m. a commen-
tary by Bhāskara or Laugākṣi Bhāskara on the
Nyāya-siddhānta-mañjarī (an elementary treatise on
the Nyāya system).
—मञ्जरी-सार or न्याय-सिद्-
धान्त-मञ्जरी-सार, अम्, n. a commentary by
Yādava Vyāsa on the Nyāya-siddhānta-mañjarī.

मञ्जरिका, f. = मञ्जरी in कटु-म्˚, पुष्प-
म्˚; N. of a princess.

मञ्जरित, अस्, आ, अम्, having clusters of flowers
[]
or branching flower-stalks; mounted on a stalk (as
a bud &c.).

मञ्जा, f. a cluster of blossoms, a branching flower-
stalk; a creeper; = अजा, a she-goat.

मञ्जि, इस्, or मञ्जी, f. a cluster of blossoms, &c.
[cf. अङ्गार-मञ्जी]; a creeper.
—मञ्जि-फला, f.
the plantain tree, Musa Sapientum.
मञ्जिका, f. a harlot, courtezan.

मञ्जिमन्, आ, m. (fr. मञ्जु), beauty, loveliness,
elegance.

मञ्जिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (probably superl. of
मञ्जु, according to Pāṇ. fr. मञ्जि), bright red
(as the Indian madder); (आ), f. Bengal or Indian
madder, Rubia Mujista; [cf. माञ्जिष्ठ.]
—मञ्-
जिष्ठाभ (˚ठ-आभ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having the
colour of Indian madder.
—मञ्जिष्टा-मेह, अस्,
m., N. of a disease in which the urine is of a light
red colour.
—मञ्जिष्ठा-मेहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, suffering
from the above disease.
—मञ्जिष्ठा-राग, अस्, m.
the colour or dye of the Indian madder; an attach-
ment charming and durable as the colour of the
Indian madder, permanent attachment.

माञ्जिष्ठ माञ्जिष्ठ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. मञ्जिष्-
ठा), red as madder, red as the dye made from
the Mañjiṣṭhā; (अम्), n. red, red colour.

मञ्जीर, अस्, अम्, m. n. an ornament for the
feet or toes, a ring, bangle, foot-oprnament, anklet;
(अम्), n. a post round which the string of the churn-
ing-stick passes; a metre, four times ˘¯˘¯¯˘˘˘
¯˘¯˘¯; (आ), f., N. of a river.
मञ्जीरक, अस्, m. a proper N.; [cf. माञ्जीरक.]

माञ्जीरक माञ्जीरक, अस्, m. (fr. मञ्जीरक),
a patronymic (Gaṇa Śivādi to Pāṇ. IV. 1, 112).

मञ्जील, अस्, m. a village inhabited especially by
washermen.

मञ्जु, उस्, उस्, उ (perhaps corrupted fr. मनो-
ज्ञ, but said to be fr. rt. मञ्ज्), beautiful, lovely,
charming, pleasing, agreeable, sweet.
—मञ्जु-कुल,
अस्, m. a proper N.
—मञ्जु-केशिन्, ई, m. ‘beautiful-
haired,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu.
—मञ्जु-
गमन, अस्, आ, अम्, going beautifully or with
graceful movements; (आ), f. a goose; a flamingo.
—मञ्जु-गर्त, a N. of Nepal.
—मञ्जु-गिर्, ईर्,
ईर्, ईर्, having a charming voice, singing sweetly.
—मञ्जु-गीति, इस्, f. a metre consisting of 29 + 30
syllables.
—मञ्जु-गुञ्ज, अस्, m. a charming murmur
or humming.
—मञ्जु-घोष, अस्, आ, अम्, having a
sweet voice or cry, uttering a sweet sound; (अस्), m.
= मञ्जु-श्री; N. of a deity worshipped by the
Tāntrikas; (आ), f., N. of an Apsaras.
—मञ्जु-
देव and मञ्जु-नाथ, अस्, m. = मञ्जु-श्री.
—मञ्जु-नाशी, f. a beautiful woman (‘destroying
or eclipsing other beautiful women?’); epithet of
the wife of Indra; of Durgā; (perhaps for मञ्जु-
नारी.)
—मञ्जु-नेत्र, अम्, n. a beautiful eye; (अस्,
आ, अम्), lovely-eyed.
—मञ्जु-पत्तन, अम्, n., N.
of a town built by Mañju-śrī.
—मञ्जु-पाठक,
अस्, m. ‘repeating beautifully,’ a parrot.
—मञ्जु-
प्राण, अस्, m. an epithet of Brahmā.
—मञ्जु-
भद्र, अस्, m. = मञ्जु-श्री.
—मञ्जु-भाषिन्, ई,
इणी, इ, sweetly speaking; (इणी), f. a particular metre.
—मञ्जु-मञ्जीर, अस्, अम्, m. n. a beautiful foot-
ornament.
—मञ्जु-मती, f., N. of a princess.
—मञ्जु-वक्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, beautiful faced, lovely,
handsome.
—मञ्जु-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, speaking beauti-
fully (as a parrot).
—मञ्जु-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, speak-
ing delightfully; (इनी), f. a kind of metre, four
times ˘¯˘¯¯˘˘˘¯˘¯˘¯; N. of a woman.
—मञ्जु-श्री, ईस्, m., N. of one of the most cele-
brated Bodhi-sattvas among the northern Buddhists.
—मञ्जुश्री-परिपृच्छा, f., N. of a Buddhist work.
—मञ्जुश्री-पर्वत, अस्, m., N. of a mountain.
—मञ्जुश्री-मूल-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Buddhist
work.
—मञ्जुश्री-विक्रीडित, अम्, n., N. of a Bud-
dhist work.
—मञ्जु-सौरभ, अम्, n. a kind of
metre, two lines of ˘˘˘˘¯˘˘¯˘¯˘¯, ˘˘¯˘¯
˘˘˘¯˘¯˘¯.
—मञ्जु-स्वन, अस्, आ, अम्, sweet-
sounding.
—मञ्जु-स्वर, अस्, m. = मञ्जु-श्री;
(अस्, आ, अम्), sounding or buzzing sweetly (as
bees).

मञ्जुल, अस्, आ, अम्, beautiful, pleasing, agreeable,
charming, lovely, sweet, soft, melodious; (अस्), m.
a species of water-hen or gallinule (= दात्यूह,
जल-रङ्क, जल-रङ्कु); (आ), f., N. of a river;
(अम्), n. a bower, arbour (= कुञ्ज); a spring, well,
natural water-course or channel (= जलाञ्चल); the
[]
fruit of Ficus Oppositifolia, Vallisneria Octandra;
variegated or the state of being variegated (= श-
वल or शैवल?).
मञ्जुलिका, f., N. of a woman.

मञ्जूषा मञ्जूषा, f. (sometimes written
मञ्जुषा; according to Uṇādi-s. IV. 77, fr. rt.
मज्ज्), a box, chest, case (for a bow &c.); recep-
tacle, (sometimes at the end of titles of works,
cf. धातु-न्याय-म्˚); a basket, large basket, ham-
per; N. of a work by Nāgeśa (abridged from the full
title Vaiyākaraṇa-siddhānta-mañjūṣā); N. of a com-
mentary on a work called Jagadīśa-toṣiṇī; = मञ्-
जिष्ठा, Bengal madder; a stone.
—मञ्जूषा-
कुञ्चिका, f. ‘key to the Mañjūṣā,’ N. of a com-
mentary by Kṛṣṇa-mitra on Nāgeśa's Mañjūṣā.

मञ्जूषक, अस्, m., N. of a species of celestial
flower; [cf. महा-म्˚.]

माञ्जिष्ठक or माञ्जिष्ठिक, अस्, ई, अम्, red
as Bengal madder, dyed with madder, red.
